entities.name: Lizard Union (medieval)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Lizard Union or Lizard League was an organization of Prussian nobles and knights established in Culmerland in 1397. Its declared goal was to combat lawlessness, although it discreetly sought the transfer of Culmerland from the Teutonic Order to Poland.
